## Problem

Given a string `s` and an integer array `shift`, apply the indicated positional shifts to the string and return the resulting string. A positive shift moves the string to the right, while a negative shift moves it to the left. Optimize the implementation.

## Input
`s = "abc"`, `shift = [1, -1, 3]`

## Output
`"cab"`

## Input Constraints
- The string length is at most 100.

### Example
**Input:**
```text
abc
1 -1 3
```

**Output:**

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

The net shift is the sum of all shifts modulo the string length.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Use string slicing or concatenation to rotate by the net displacement.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

Watch for the case when the string is empty or the net shift is zero.

</details>
